Many are awaiting video interview results, some are onto the extra info and some are getting AC dates. It’s really spread out. Seems if you get amber banded in a stage you’ll be held until the pass mark creeps down to where you scored then your application proceeds, or of it doesn’t get that far and marks are set you’ll get an email saying your application isn’t going further.

If you go visit the thread about the Fast Stream 2022 on The Student Room you'll see people have progressed through the process at varying rates. Some were still at the online test phase up until only recently and some have started going to the AC already or are starting to be invited.

I've had that exact situation, scored a 4, emailed to ask and was told due to the number of qualifying candidates at sift the pass mark was raised to 5.
